user_goal: Implement W2 Phase 04 Benchmark and Proof: create eight reproducible benchmark fixtures, execute fair raw-versus-W2 runs with stored external verification, generate results from raw data, and document limitations without starting Phase 05.
functional_requirements: Define at least eight meaningful fixtures across multiple task categories with reset commands and external verifiers
Run and preserve both raw Codex and W2 plus Codex condition artifacts without cherry-picking failures
Capture correctness, evidence coverage, efficiency, and human-effort metrics only when measured
Generate results JSON and CSV plus a judge-readable benchmark report from stored raw data
nonfunctional_requirements: Same task wording, baseline, acceptance criteria, verifier, and local model configuration are used for both conditions
Infrastructure failures are distinct from task failures
Public claims trace to stored benchmark results; no fabricated model or token metrics
constraints: Do not start Phase 05 UI/demo or Phase 06 packaging

semantic_relevance.name: persistence
rules: all raw runs and verifier output remain addressable on disk

semantic_relevance.name: testing
rules: every fixture has an independent verifier

semantic_relevance.name: security
rules: scope violations are measured, not hidden

semantic_relevance.name: concurrency
rules: repeated runs do not mutate the shared baseline

semantic_relevance.name: external_dependency
rules: benchmark runner uses only local stored fixtures

acceptance_criteria.statement: At least eight meaningful benchmark fixtures span multiple categories and each contains baseline, task, constraints, allowed paths, acceptance criteria, verifier, and reset command
Raw and W2 conditions use the same fixture contract and differences are recorded
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: benchmark methodology and run metadata validation

acceptance_criteria.statement: False-DONE and evidence coverage are defined and measured fields are captured without invented values
Raw and W2 runs including failures are stored and comparative JSON/CSV are generated from them
Benchmark report contains methodology, case study, limitations, and claims traceable to stored results
Another developer can rerun fixture validation and result generation from documented commands
